source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1, 5. Ἀρξάντων τε καὶ εὐφρανθέντων τῷ τὸν κύριον διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβημάτων εἰς ταπείνωσιν παραδεδωκέναι τοὺς τὰς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις λογίοις συνθήκας πρὸς αὐτὸν οὐ τετηρηκότας.
pass_a_gloss: Both having ruled and having rejoiced because the Lord, on account of the multitude of the impieties, handed over unto tapeinōsis / humiliation those who had not kept the covenants with him in the holy oracles.
pass_b_english: Both having ruled and having rejoiced because the Lord, on account of the multitude of the impieties, handed over unto humiliation those who had not kept the covenants with him in the holy oracles.

choices.why: Origen’s fr. 11 turns on the agapan vs philein contrast in Lam 1:2.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations for sense disclosed in translator_notes.
